integrity: The count is proved by square-zero image/kernel classification and a q-product parity argument. Direct finite checks corroborate through ambient dimension four; no independent audit or certification is claimed.
limitations: Only self-inverse partial affine bijections between binary affine subspaces, including the empty map, are counted; no claim for arbitrary partial permutations, non-binary fields, or non-self-inverse transformations. Limits are asymptotic in ambient dimension. Publication priority remains provisional pending independent review.
title: Fixed-point-free involutions in the finite binary affine-partial inverse monoid: a half-density law
